description: TransiEnt (TransiEnt Library) is an open energy model listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Open Models", published or maintained by Hamburg University of Technology. The TransiEnt library is written in the Modelica modeling language and allows simulations of coupled energy networks with high share of renewable energies. The library can be downloaded for free and open source under the Modelica License 2. Coverage: Hamburg / Germany. The fact sheet classes it as: Dynamic system simulation model library. Sectors: electricity, district heating, Gas,. Resolution: time Second, geography Metropolregion Hamburg. Data availability is given as "some". The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the fact sheet. Caveats: this record was written from the openmod wiki fact sheet, which was read; the source code and documentation were not opened, and the sheet may be out of date (it carries no update date). It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
